policies.rightsHolder: Per-edition translator/publisher as identified by QuranEnc
policies.attributionText: Publisher and QuranEnc.com source must be shown with version information.
policies.cacheLimit: No explicit cache duration stated; keep content updated to latest source version.

releaseConstraints: Do not modify, add to, or delete translation content.

Do not place inappropriate advertisements when displaying Quran translations.
Do not expose in production catalogue until edition-specific commercial/ad-supported redistribution permission is recorded.
